stem.text: A circuit contains two resistors, P and Q, and a power supply of negligible internal resistance, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with two resistors in series, labelled P and Q, connected to two open terminals.

stem.text: The current in resistor P is $2.0\,\text{A}$ and the power dissipated by resistor P is $18\,\text{W}$.
Resistor Q dissipates $240\,\text{J}$ of energy when a charge of $40\,\text{C}$ passes through it.
What is the electromotive force (e.m.f.) of the power supply?
